summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, containing a press release with assay results from a bulk sample at its Apex mine in Utah, acquired on March 16, 2026. The release reports grades of 0.180% germanium, 0.0273% gallium, and 1.96% copper and discusses metallurgical testing, potential direct shipping ore sales, and permitting targeting Q2-2027. No specific deal terms, prices, or premiums are disclosed. This filing updates project progress, not a special-situation event; it is an ordinary operational update.
